errors.evidence: The y-axis in the figure extends to 40 (with tick marks up to 30 visible), not just 0 to 30.

errors.text_span: Isolate and Uralic generally show near-zero effects across all models
errors.evidence: Uralic is near zero, but Isolate includes small positive/negative values around 0–2 and is not uniformly near zero across all models; the statement overstates the uniformity.

errors.text_span: mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ tend to show higher effects in IE-Indic, IE-Slavic, and Semitic families
errors.evidence: While generally true, the wording implies a consistent trend across these families; in Semitic, XLM-B₂ is around 20 and mBERT-B₂ around 15, but several other models also have substantial values, so the claim is somewhat overgeneralized.
The description does not mention the y-axis tick interval/scale detail visible in the figure (linear scale with ticks every 5 units).
